verdict: No open implementation blockers within the materialization/seal-recovery website component scope.

resolved.prior: A previously opened tab could use stale in-memory intent and overwrite another pending seal reference after takeover.
resolved.resolution: Strict IndexedDB readwrite reservation atomically adds the single current record only when absent and resolves only on transaction completion. Page re-reads durable intent before commands and after open/prepare. Same-reference settlement prevents stale overwrite. Notifications are supplemental.
resolved.independentRegression: Actual Chromium page-controls show existing second-tab admission refuses with BroadcastChannel disabled, including forced stale button events; actual IndexedDB concurrent reservations yield exactly one success.
